title: Microsoft Teams Phone Enablement — Calling Plans & Operator Connect
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft 365 Teams administration).

MicrosoftTeams PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Turn on enterprise voice in Teams Phone — calling plans and Operator Connect
problem: Moving telephony into Teams Phone means choosing the right PSTN connectivity and getting numbers, policies, and emergency calling right. This solution enables Teams Phone via Microsoft Calling Plans and Operator Connect (the non-SBC paths): licensing, phone-number acquisition and assignment, calling/voice-routing and emergency-calling policy, auto attendants and call queues, and validation — so users get reliable enterprise calling. (Direct Routing via SBC is covered separately.)
whats_inside: Solution Overview — PSTN options (Calling Plans vs Operator Connect vs Direct Routing), licensing, numbers, voice routing, emergency calling, auto attendants/call queues.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (Teams Phone + calling-plan/Operator-Connect licensing, admin roles, number inventory, E911 addresses).

Implementation Guide — assign licensing, acquire + assign numbers (Calling Plans or Operator Connect), set voice-routing + emergency-calling + calling policies, build auto attendants/call queues, and validate — pilot-first, each object named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (calls in/out work, emergency calling correct, policies assigned) plus Best Practices for a reliable Teams Phone rollout.
short: Enable Teams Phone via Calling Plans / Operator Connect — licensing, number acquisition + assignment, voice-routing + emergency-calling policy, auto attendants/call queues, and validation — so users get reliable enterprise calling. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
